about: Pembroke is a city in Renfrew County, Ontario, on the Ottawa River in the Upper Ottawa Valley. A historic downtown, riverfront parks, and a long role as a lumber and service centre for the valley define the place. Highways 17 and 41 meet near the city. About 14,000 people live in Pembroke.
seoSummary: Upper Ottawa Valley city on the Ottawa River—historic downtown and Renfrew County service hub.
